Net Profit follows the statement's total comprehensive (loss) for the year, the same measure already used for FY2024. | Profit Before Tax and EPS added, and Net Profit and Income Tax corrected, from Nation Media Group Plc audited group financial results for the years ended 31 December 2025, 2024, 2023 and 2021, NSE filing library. The statements print, in KShs millions, loss or profit before income tax, income tax credit or expense, loss or profit after income tax, total comprehensive income and Earnings per share. Net Profit now follows the printed profit AFTER income tax: it previously carried total comprehensive income in all five years, FY2025 (259.7) against (308.6) after tax, FY2024 (465.4) against (254.4), FY2023 163.4 against (205.7), FY2022 470.6 against 318.5, FY2021 584.7 against 493.1. Income Tax is stored as the charge, so Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit on screen. EPS is the printed figure in KShs. | kenyanstocks.com financial statements API, farmed harvest. Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit.
